attributes.title: 2027 Thomas P. Hinman Dental Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Hinman Dental Meeting is March 18 to 20, 2027, at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta. Registration opens November 10, 2026. The meeting is an AGD PACE recognized provider and awards one hour of credit per lecture hour unless a course states otherwise.

Fees depend on role: a dentist pays $250 through February 18, 2027 and $295 after; hygienists, assistants and office staff pay $90 and $110. Reduced rates apply to dentists in their first or second year of practice and to military dentists. Free categories (students, residents, retired dentists) do not earn CE.

Full refunds are possible until noon EST on March 8, 2027. Hands-on workshops are not refundable. Total CE hours for the meeting have not been published.
